title: 凯隐·小小砂石盘
description: 黑发凯隐穿完整深色衣装，在浅盘里摆圆石，红眼大镰刀安稳放在远侧架上。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kayn is an adult man with long dark hair tied partly back, a vivid blue hair streak, a sharp face, and a recognizable red-black transformed arm. Keep the asymmetrical arm identity while covering his torso fully with a dark sleeved tunic and opaque trousers. His huge curved scythe Rhaast rests securely in a display cradle, its red eye a quiet decorative detail.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a floor cushion and carefully places a smooth round stone into a shallow sand tray, making a modest little garden. The transformed hand holds the tray edge gently rather than clawing. One plain plant pot and a pale screen form the background, while the scythe stays still and no threatening shadow shapes appear.
art_direction.palette: ink black, soft crimson, blue accent, sand cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
